Macworld

PRICES CHECKED NOVEMBER 28, 2026 – Deals change quickly, so we will update this page throughout the Black Friday weekend

See more deals and buying advice below. For more offers, visit our Black Friday coverage and our roundups of the best Mac deals, iPad deals, Apple Watch deals and AirPods deals.

Black Friday is here and we’re tracking the best Apple Black Friday deals in the U.S. and U.K., from MacBooks and iPads to AirPods, Apple Watches, and iPhones all weekend. Some of the lowest prices we’ve seen this year are already here. Start with our top picks above or jump to the product you’re shopping for via the Table of Contents. We compare prices on the same configuration so you can see which offers give you the biggest savings.

We’ll update this guide all the way to Cyber Monday on November 30 as prices change, new offers appear, and stock sells out.

If you’re shopping directly from Apple, its November 27–30 Shopping Event offers gift cards worth up to $300 in the U.S. or £240 in the U.K. with eligible purchases. Compare the gift-card value with the retailer discounts below to see which works out better for you. See Apple’s Black Friday gift-card offer and eligible products.

Best Black Friday AirPods deals

U.S.:

  • AirPods Pro 3: $149 ($100 off at Amazon, MSRP $249)
  • AirPods Max 2: $419 ($130 off at Amazon, MSRP $549)

U.K.:

  • AirPods Pro 3: £155.98 (£63 off at Amazon, RRP £219).
  • AirPods 5 (wireless charging case): £119 (£20 off at Amazon, RRP £139).
  • AirPods Max 2: £449 ($50 off at Amazon, MSRP £499)

Petter Ahrnstedt

What you need to know…

The AirPods Pro 3 are our top Black Friday pick at $149 in the U.S. or £155.98 in the U.K. The U.S. deal is $20 below the $169 low we’d previously seen. Launched in September 2025, the Pro 3 have foam-infused ear tips for a sealed fit and a built-in heart-rate sensor. In the U.K., the £119 AirPods 5 are the better choice if you prefer an open fit. If you’re happy with ear tips, the Pro 3 cost about £37 more.

Apple launched the AirPods 5 in September 2026 and made active noise cancellation standard on the $129 model. With the AirPods 4, you had to spend $179 to get noise cancellation. There’s also a $149 AirPods 5 model with a wireless charging case and on-device gesture controls.

The AirPods Max 2 are a good buy at $419 if you want them now. Apple updated its over-ear headphones in March 2026, keeping the $549 price and adding an H2 chip for better noise cancellation and features such as Live Translation and Adaptive Audio. If you’re happy to wait, we’ve seen them as low as $399, so there’s a chance to save another $20. The U.K. discount isn’t as big, but even at £50 off it’s still a good deal.

Apple’s deal: From November 27 through November 30, Apple will include an Apple Gift Card when you buy eligible AirPods directly from Apple. You’ll get $25 in the U.S. or £20 in the U.K. with AirPods 5, $50 or £40 with AirPods Pro 3, and $75 or £60 with AirPods Max 2. The U.S. retailer deals on the Pro 3 and Max 2 are better value even if you plan to spend the full gift card.

Roman Loyola/Foundry

What you need to know…

The M5 MacBook Air is the best MacBook for most people. The 13-inch model with 512GB of storage is down to $999 in the U.S. and £1,148.97 in the U.K. The U.S. deal beats the $1,099 price we saw earlier in November. If you’d prefer a bigger screen, the 15-inch Air costs about $150 or £150 more.

The MacBook Neo is our budget pick for browsing, schoolwork, and other everyday tasks. The 512GB model is $100 off at $699 in the U.S. If you can stretch to the $1,049 MacBook Air, the extra $300 gets you twice the memory (16GB versus 8GB) with the same amount of storage. In the U.K. the MacBook Neo (512GB) is £102 off at Amazon.

Apple’s October MacBook Pro update brought an M6 chip to the entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro and added a higher-end option for M5 Pro and M5 Max buyers. The new design is lighter and has a touchscreen PROLED XDR display, with a $400 premium at Apple. Black Friday deals widen that gap in the U.S.: The 16-inch M5 Pro with the standard display is about $400 cheaper than the 16-inch touchscreen model in our deals list. If you’re happy with the standard display, start there.

If you’re deciding between the 14-inch M5 and M6 MacBook Pro, compare prices with the same memory and storage. The chip is the main change, so if the price gap is small, we’d lean toward the M6. If the M5 gets you more memory or storage for about the same money, it could be the better buy for your workload.

Apple’s deal: Apple’s deal runs November 27–30. Buy an eligible 13-inch or 15-inch M5 MacBook Air directly from Apple and you’ll get a $200 U.S. or £160 U.K. Apple Gift Card. Eligible M5 Pro and M5 Max MacBook Pro models come with $250 or £200 for the 14-inch and $300 or £240 for the 16-inch. The M6 MacBook Pro and touchscreen models are excluded. Compare Apple’s offer with the retailer price and factor in how much of the gift card you’d actually use.

  • Mac mini (M5 Pro, 512GB, 24GB): £1,454 (£245 off at Amazon, RRP £1,699)

Simon Jary / Foundry

What you need to know…

The M6 Mac mini is our desktop Mac pick at $779 in the U.S. or £759 in the U.K. if you already have a display. We’ve seen the M6 Mac mini model drop by as much as $150 in the U.S., and advise watching in case that deal returns. Amazon also still has the M4 Mac mini for $150 off if you want to spend less.

Choose the M6 iMac if you want an all-in-one with a built-in display. The iMac and Mac mini both got chip updates this fall, with an M5 Pro option for the higher-end Mac mini. Both kept their existing designs. The M6 iMac only went on sale in early November, so we’ve had less time to see how far its price might fall.

The Mac Studio is worth considering if your work calls for M5 Max or M5 Ultra performance. We’ve seen discounts of up to $200, but starting prices are higher this generation. The M5 Max starts at $2,499, up $500, while the M5 Ultra starts at $5,499, up $1,500 from the M3 Ultra. For everyday use, the Mac mini or iMac is a better value.

Apple’s deal — From November 27 through November 30, Apple will include a $100 gift card in the U.S. or an £80 gift card in the U.K. when you buy a Mac mini. The iMac and Mac Studio are excluded.

Mahmoud Itani / Foundry

What you need to know…

In the U.S., the $299 Apple Watch Series 12 is our pick for most buyers. The $179 Apple Watch SE 3 is the best budget option at $70 off. Apple didn’t update the SE this year, but it already has an always-on display, a temperature sensor, on-device Siri, and fast charging.

In the U.K., the £260 Apple Watch Series 11 is the better value. It’s £99 cheaper than the same-size Series 12 at its current deal price of £359, or £159 cheaper than the usual price of the equivalent Series 12. If you want an Ultra, the £495 Apple Watch Ultra 3 saves you £224 compared with the discounted Ultra 4 at £719.

The Series 12 and Ultra 4 are modest upgrades over last year’s models. Both use Apple’s new S11 chip, which has a faster Neural Engine for features like Live Rewind and Siri Recap. If those features appeal to you, the new models are worth a look. Otherwise, the current U.K. discounts make last year’s models easy to recommend.

Apple’s deal: From November 27 through November 30, Apple will include a $50 gift card in the U.S. or £40 in the U.K. with an eligible Apple Watch Series 12 or SE 3 bought directly from Apple. The Ultra 4 comes with a $100 or £80 gift card. Compare the price you’ll pay upfront and how much of the gift card you expect to use.

Foundry

What you need to know…

The 128GB iPad (A16) at $379 is our budget pick for browsing, streaming, and everyday apps. If you want more power for creative apps or multitasking, step up to the 11-inch iPad Air (M4) at $649. The Air got a faster chip in March, but little else changed, and the entry-level iPad and M5 iPad Pro are the same models Apple introduced in 2025. Apple raised U.S. iPad prices by $100 to $200 in June, so even some Black Friday prices may be higher than what you would have paid last year.

The iPad mini (A20 Pro) at $599 is the one to buy if you specifically want a smaller tablet. Apple gave it a major overhaul in October, with an 8.5-inch OLED display, a thinner design, a landscape FaceTime camera, and IP67 water resistance. The new mini starts at $699, up from the previous model’s original $499 starting price. At $100 off, we’d choose the new mini unless you find a steep clearance discount on the older model.

The 11-inch iPad Pro (M5) at $1,499 is a good U.S. deal if you need 1TB of storage. In the U.K., the savings on the iPad Pro are minimal, unfortunately.

Apple’s deal: From November 27 through November 30, Apple will include a $100 or £80 Apple Gift Card with an eligible 11-inch or 13-inch M4 iPad Air, or a $125 or £100 gift card with an eligible 11-inch or 13-inch M5 iPad Pro. The standard iPad and iPad mini are excluded. In the U.S., Amazon’s $649 iPad Air gives you the same $100 saving upfront.

What you need to know…

Most iPhone deals in the U.S. come from carriers and require a trade-in or a new line. Before signing up, compare what you’ll pay for the phone and the required plan over the full bill-credit period. Check whether you’ll lose any remaining credits if you switch carriers or pay off the phone early.

In the U.K., you can buy an unlocked iPhone at a discount and choose your own plan. The £799 iPhone Air is a good pick if you want a slim phone and are happy with a single rear camera. If you want a dedicated telephoto camera, we’ve seen the £999 iPhone 17 Pro for £200 less than the equivalent iPhone 18 Pro, but that’s now out of stock. Apple no longer sells the iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max, but both are still available from retailers. We are even seeing a £30 discount for the iPhone 18 Pro, but nothing for the 18 Pro Max

Apple’s deal: From November 27 through November 30, Apple will include a $100 U.S. or £80 U.K. Apple Gift Card with an iPhone Air, a $75 U.S. or £60 U.K. Apple Gift Card with an iPhone 17 or iPhone 16, and a $50 U.S. or £40 U.K. Apple Gift Card with an iPhone 17e. The iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Duo are excluded from the offer.

What you need to know…

The second-generation AirTag four-pack is our top Apple accessory deal at $79 in the U.S. or £74 in the U.K. The U.K. deal matches the lowest price we’ve previously seen for a four-pack. In the U.S., we’ve seen the original AirTags drop to $65, so check which generation you’re getting before you buy.

We’re also tracking Black Friday discounts on mice and keyboards for your Mac, Apple Pencils and Magic Keyboards for your iPad, and charging cables and adapters. Before you order, check which Apple Pencil works with your iPad. For a Magic Keyboard, check your iPad’s model, generation, and screen size against the compatibility list.

Apple’s deal. From November 27 through November 30, Apple will include a $25 U.S. or £20 U.K. Apple Gift Card when you buy an eligible Apple Pencil Pro or Magic Keyboard for iPad Air or iPad Pro directly from Apple. Selected chargers from Anker, Belkin, Mophie, and Twelve South also qualify, as do selected Rains sleeves. Apple is offering gift cards worth $50 or £40 with HomePod, $25 or £20 with HomePod mini 2, and up to $75 or £60 with eligible Beats headphones. If you already have another Apple purchase in mind, factor in the gift card when you compare Apple’s offer with retailer discounts.

Black Friday 2026: Where to shop for Apple deals

Stay tuned to Macworld between Black Friday and Cyber Monday to find the best deals as they arrive. But if you’re looking for a specific color or capacity, you can check out the following retailers. In the U.S., here are the best stores to shop for Black Friday deals:

  • Apple – no direct discounts, gift card giveaway confirmed
  • Amazon – widest range and often the deepest short-term discounts, but stock moves quickly
  • Adorama – a wide range of Macs that includes older models.
  • Best Buy – wide range of deals on popular Apple products
  • B&H Photo: good selection of deals on MacBooks and desktop Macs
  • Costco – some deals on popular Apple products, watch out for restored and older models
  • Target – some deals on popular Apple products
  • Walmart – some deals on popular Apple products, watch out for restored and older models

If you’re based in the U.K., you’ll find deals at the following shops:

  • Apple – no direct discounts, gift card giveaway confirmed
  • AO.com – grants larger discounts to AO members (£39.99 annually)
  • Amazon – widest range and often the deepest short-term discounts, but stock moves quickly
  • Argos – some discounts
  • Currys – a mix of new and older models
  • eBuyer – limited selection of deals, watch out for postage prices
  • John Lewis – mostly current products, with a few older models
  • KRCS – good selection, but not as many models as the Apple Store
  • Laptops Direct – stock includes old and new models.
  • Very – good selection of deals

How we pick the best Apple deals

At Macworld we’ve been covering and reviewing Apple and Apple devices for more than 40 years, from the original Macintosh to the most recent M6 MacBook Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. Our recommendations draw on hands-on reviews and price comparisons, and we use Apple products every day (and buy most of them ourselves), so we know a good deal when we see one.

With a working knowledge of everything Apple sells and decades of experience, we know when stores are inflating MSRPs or pushing “normal” sales as limited Black Friday deals. Rest assured, the listings you see here will only be for the best discounts we can find on that particular item.
